descriptors.name: line.length
descriptors.label: Length
descriptors.tip: How far each arm extends from its starting point in game pixels.

descriptors.name: line.thickness
descriptors.label: Thickness
descriptors.tip: Width of each crosshair line in game pixels.

descriptors.name: line.gap
descriptors.label: Gap
descriptors.tip: Inner distance between the center point and the start of each arm.

descriptors.name: line.arm_count
descriptors.label: Arm Count
descriptors.tip: Number of radially distributed arms around the center.

descriptors.name: dot.diameter
descriptors.label: Center Dot Diameter
descriptors.tip: Size of the central reticle dot in game pixels.

descriptors.name: glow.radius
descriptors.label: Glow Radius
descriptors.tip: Outer radiant dispersion radius for glow effects (max 64 px).

descriptors.name: glow.intensity
descriptors.label: Glow Intensity
descriptors.tip: Brightness intensity multiplier of the glow bloom.

descriptors.name: global.scale
descriptors.label: Master Scale
descriptors.tip: Uniform scaling multiplier applied to the entire composite crosshair.

descriptors.name: global.opacity
descriptors.label: Master Opacity
descriptors.tip: Overall visibility transparency of the reticle.

descriptors.name: position.x
descriptors.label: X Offset
descriptors.tip: Horizontal position relative to center in game pixels.

descriptors.name: position.y
descriptors.label: Y Offset
descriptors.tip: Vertical position relative to center in game pixels.

descriptors.name: position.mode
descriptors.label: Position Mode
descriptors.tip: Relative (delta) or Absolute (from reticle center) coordinates.

descriptors.name: nudge.step
descriptors.label: Nudge Step
descriptors.tip: Movement distance per nudge arrow press in game pixels.

descriptors.name: paint.color
descriptors.label: Reticle Color
descriptors.tip: Reticle fill color in hex format (#RGB, #RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA).

descriptors.name: recenter.selection
descriptors.label: Recenter Selection
descriptors.tip: Moves selected layers back to exact center (0, 0). Shortcut: Home.

descriptors.name: rect.width
descriptors.label: Rectangle Width
descriptors.tip: Width of rectangle layer in game pixels.

descriptors.name: rect.height

descriptors.tip: Height of rectangle layer in game pixels.

descriptors.name: rect.corner_radius
descriptors.label: Corner Radius

descriptors.name: circle.diameter
descriptors.label: Circle Diameter
descriptors.tip: Total outer diameter of circle in game pixels.

descriptors.name: ring.outer_radius
descriptors.label: Ring Outer Radius
descriptors.tip: Outer radius of circular ring in game pixels.

descriptors.name: ring.inner_radius
descriptors.label: Ring Inner Radius
descriptors.tip: Inner cutout radius of ring in game pixels.

descriptors.name: arc.radius
descriptors.label: Arc Radius
descriptors.tip: Radius of circular arc in game pixels.

descriptors.name: polygon.sides
descriptors.label: Polygon Sides

descriptors.name: triangle.base

descriptors.tip: Width of triangle base in game pixels.

descriptors.name: chevron.arm_length

descriptors.tip: Length of each chevron wing in game pixels.

descriptors.name: t_shape.bar_length
descriptors.label: T-Shape Bar Length
descriptors.tip: Horizontal top bar length of T-shape in game pixels.

descriptors.name: plus.length
descriptors.label: Plus Arm Length
descriptors.tip: Length of plus cross arms in game pixels.

descriptors.name: path.stroke_width

descriptors.tip: Width of vector Bézier path stroke in game pixels.

descriptors.name: pixels.grid_size
descriptors.label: Pixel Grid Dimension
descriptors.tip: Resolution of custom pixel matrix grid (e.g. 16 for 16x16).

descriptors.name: image.scale
descriptors.label: Image Scale
descriptors.tip: Scaling factor for custom sprite image layer.

descriptors.name: glow.radius
descriptors.label: Glow Radius
descriptors.tip: Diffusion spread radius of Gaussian glow in game pixels.

descriptors.name: shadow.blur
descriptors.label: Drop Shadow Blur
descriptors.tip: Blur radius of drop shadow in game pixels.

descriptors.name: bloom.intensity

descriptors.tip: HDR luminance threshold boost for high-contrast reticle visibility.

descriptors.name: theme.id

descriptors.tip: Monochromatic UI chrome theme (mono-dark, mono-light, graphite-mint, etc.).

descriptors.name: appearance.font_pack
descriptors.label: Font Pack
descriptors.tip: Bundled WOFF2 typography pack (satoshi, technical, editorial, plex, space, system).

descriptors.name: appearance.corner_style
descriptors.label: Corner Style
descriptors.tip: UI component corner radius scale: sharp, default (max 8px), or soft (max 10px).
